current.name: Fmdac
current.description: Fmdac 0.4, identity FM-1_964. Eight tracks: KICK, SNARE, HAT, TOM, and silent MIDI tracks M1–M4. SELECT, SEL, and K4 change the track. HOME cycles synthesized 808, 909, CR-78, and SDS characters. SEQ cycles a step grid, a keys-and-cursor piano roll, and a song chain. PLAY walks that chain when its length is more than one pattern. REC while stopped quantizes a short performance into the pattern and sets the BPM. ARP has up, down, up-down, random, chord, order, and latch. A second press of ENV sends a MIDI CC envelope. EDIT sets GM drum notes and the MIDI-track channels. FX runs Prophet VS, DX7, SP-1200, Emulator II, or S950. While the computer streams audio to the FM-1, that audio is converted on the way to the headphones. When nothing is streaming, the headphones hear the FM-1's own mix. The computer records the headphone mix. No sample ROMs. The take is quantized, not a looper. There is no OCTACHRON factory map.
